newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal Plus unit in deal for Japan channels.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus unit in deal for Japan channels.

text.p: Multithematiques, a subsidiary of Canal Plus, said it signed an accord with Jupiter Programming Company Ltd and leading U.S. cable television group Tele-Communications International Inc to create two channels for cable and satellite television viewers in Japan.
Jupiter, Japan's largest cable television multiple system operator, is a unit of Sumitomo Corp.
The first channel will be dedicated to films and European lifestyles, while the second will be a French adaptation of Canal Jimmy, Multithematiques said in a statement.

Canal Jimmy targets an intellectual audience influenced by American culture, offering for example selected U.S. situation comedies and series, programmes on country music and some British political satire.
Multithematiques already has a presence in Spain, Poland and Germany. In France it runs Canal Jimmy, documentary channel Planete, Seasons, and film channels Cine-Cinemas and Cine-Cinefil.
